class.name: NoqeriScript
class.brief_description: NoeEngine's native script resource for supported Noqeri (.nqr) scene files.
class.description: NoqeriScript lets .nqr scripts appear in the built-in Script editor and attach to scene nodes. NoeEngine 0.1.0-dev uses a restricted Noqeri game-scripting subset translated to the existing Godot scripting VM. The complete Noqeri language, standard library, ABI, and self-hosted compiler are not embedded. Unsupported constructs fail with an error. A scene script may declare a base type using a leading [code]// noeengine:extends Node2D[/code] directive. Supported statements include function declarations, variables, conditions, while loops, return, and calls accepted by the Godot VM.
